in_marathi.name: Monjit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector of the universe
in_marathi.long_meaning: Monjit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Monjit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'monj', meaning 'protector'. The suffix 'it' denotes the one who has the power to protect. In Hindu mythology, Monjit is the deity who is believed to protect the universe and its inhabitants. The name is also associated with courage, strength, and wisdom.
